verdict.rationale: Railway's own site states the story almost word for word: "Unlimited environments mean everyone can ship simultaneously." Per-pull-request previews and environment management through its MCP server back this up. The evidence is marketing-level only, and isolation between environments is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how environments are isolated (separate variables, databases and networking), any stated limits on environment count, and independent or hands-on confirmation of teams running many environments at once.
